messages:
maria: Quick sync — who is taking ownership of the Wed release slot (10:30 UTC) for the release train? We have backend change (ryan), runtime routing tweak (kevin), and need smoke + rollback readiness. Please call dibs and confirm deploy window.

kevin: I can own runtime. Planning to push PR #987 that changes model routing policy. Targeting 10:30 deploy, canary at 10:35. Will post the image tag here once built. @sophia please lmk if that timing collides with smoke ops. :thumbsup:

ryan: I’ll take backend deploy. PR 2145 is ready, just waiting on a small test fix — should be merged by EOD. I can be online at 10:20 UTC to coordinate. Will monitor logs and roll metrics for the first 15m.

sophia: I’ll own smoke and rollback. Smoke checklist (quick):
1) Hitting /health returns 200 for all regions
2) 95/99p gen latency within baseline (<300ms after canary)
3) No error spike in model-routing traces
4) Sanity exports for embeddings (sample corpus)
I’ll run the quick smoke job and post results in this thread. If anything fails, we rollback to tag v1.12.3 and run the rollback checklist. :white_check_mark:

maria: Great — owning release coordination. Two notes: 1) Keep canary at 5% for first 5m, then 25% for next 10m if healthy. 2) If model routing PR changes config format, add a compatibility flag so older nodes don't crash.

kevin: noted on compatibility flag. Will deploy as runtime:model-route:v2026-03-17-987 (I’ll update with exact digest once the CI finishes). Canary policy: 5% @10:35, 25% @10:40, full at 10:55 if all green.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary rollout for release-window starting 2054321987. Canary start: 10:35 UTC, owner: kevin, backend owner: ryan. Approvals: pending (maria). To cancel: /deploy cancel 2054321987

ryan: Quick smoke helpers (I’ll run these from ops namespace at 10:36):
```
# healthcheck hit
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://api.redwood.example/health
# small inference sanity
python smoke_check.py --sample 100 --endpoint https://api.redwood.example/generate
```
I’ll paste logs and a link to the live Kibana query for the error rate.

sophia: If anyone is offline, I’ll annotate the smoke run with quick pass/fail and attach the minimal metrics snapshot. Rollback plan condensed: rollback to v1.12.3, clear kv cache if routing stateful mismatch, and trigger a quick reindex of prefix cache (if needed). I’ll own executing rollback if we hit >2% error or >30% latency regression.

maria: Approving schedule now. :rocket: @deploy-bot you can proceed with the canary at 10:35 UTC. Please ping on completion of each stage.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 10:35 UTC (5%). Status updates will follow in this thread.

kevin: Image pushed: runtime:model-route@sha256:abcd1234... Canary probes show no immediate errors.

sophia: Smoke run complete @10:41 — health checks 200, latency 95p=210ms, errors steady at baseline. Marking canary stage 1 PASS. Moving to 25% at 10:40 as planned. :white_check_mark:

ryan: Backend deploy logs look clean. No exceptions in the first 10m. Kibana dashboard: https://kibana.example/d/abcd1234?live (monitoring) :eyes:

maria: Thanks all. If no objections by 10:55 we proceed to full rollout. Hold on rollback readiness just in case. Good job keeping slots tight.

sophia: will standby for 10:55. I’ll kick rollback if metrics breach thresholds.

maria: Closing loop — full rollout executed at 10:56, post-deploy alerts quiet. Leaving postmortem notes in release docs later. :tada:
